accepted_conditions.expiry: Expires when superseded by accepted measured reachability evidence.
accepted_conditions.required_action: Run a sound module-reachability experiment with before/after manifests and repeat affected Phases 3–10 proofs.
accepted_conditions.trigger: Before release qualification or material bundle composition change

accepted_conditions.expiry: Expires when an accepted production-serving profile supersedes the local estimate.
accepted_conditions.required_action: Verify actual precompressed serving, negotiation, MIME, integrity, cache, isolation, proxy, and CDN behavior.
accepted_conditions.trigger: Before production profile deployment or transfer-size claim

accepted_conditions.expiry: Expires only on accepted same-boundary stable-product evidence.
accepted_conditions.required_action: Attribute harness/runtime phases, optimize without changing semantics, and repeat the same timer distribution in a stable Firefox product.
accepted_conditions.trigger: Before stable Firefox support or interaction-budget promotion

accepted_conditions.expiry: Reevaluated at every private dependency revision.
accepted_conditions.required_action: Repeat private-surface inventory and compatibility probes while retaining standalone DOM fallback and neutral package isolation.
accepted_conditions.trigger: Any Phoenix, LiveView, LocalLiveView, or optional adapter change

accepted_conditions.expiry: Reevaluated at every named runtime or toolchain change.
accepted_conditions.required_action: Repeat affected runtime, browser, behavior, resilience, measurement, and clean-rebuild proofs from immutable inputs.
accepted_conditions.trigger: Any runtime, OTP, Popcorn, toolchain, bridge, or canonical build-root change

accepted_conditions.expiry: Expires only through an accepted production security gate.
accepted_conditions.required_action: Design and validate production identity, TLS/proxy, persistence, distributed limits, CSP, audit, monitoring, and penetration-test controls.
accepted_conditions.trigger: Before production authentication, deployment, or security claim

accepted_conditions.expiry: Remains open until BH-22 qualification accepts or rejects each deferred row.
accepted_conditions.required_action: Execute non-substitutable platform, stable-browser, physical-device, mobile, and manual assistive-technology qualification.
accepted_conditions.trigger: BH-22 start or availability of representative external environments

accepted_conditions.expiry: Expires only when BH-02 accepts independently reviewed neutral contracts.
accepted_conditions.required_action: Derive neutral contracts from observable facts and prohibit BH-01 messages, DOM operations, Phoenix routes, and profile fixtures from becoming public APIs by default.
accepted_conditions.trigger: During BH-02 semantic, renderer, capability, effect, or resource contract design

accepted_conditions.expiry: Expires only through an accepted release gate.
accepted_conditions.required_action: Complete SBOM, license/notice, signing, source-map, reachability, production serving, rollback, provenance, and release invalidation gates.
accepted_conditions.trigger: Before package publication or release-readiness claim

approvals.basis: The explicit Phase 10 authorization includes making and immediately merging the evidence-based BH-02 entry decision.

bh02_entry.required_next_action: complete Phase 10 integration and receive explicit repository-owner BH-02 authorization

rationale: The candidate reconstructs exactly in two independent clean contexts on the available Linux host, executes required active semantics without violating renderer or server-authority boundaries, and retains every adverse result. Payload economics, Firefox timer behavior, exact private pins, production controls, release work, and external qualification remain bounded conditions rather than manufactured passes.
